extracted.name: Japanese Zucchini and Onions
extracted.description: This Japanese zucchini and onion stir-fry recipe, with sesame seeds, teriyaki, and soy sauces, comes together in minutes to make a tasty vegetarian meal.
ingredient_lines: 2 medium zucchinis, cut into thin strips
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion; cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add zucchini, teriyaki sauce, soy sauce, and sesame seeds; cook until zucchini are tender, about 5 minutes. Season with pepper. Serve immediately.
